title: dev.qory.run.heartbeat
description: The run is alive. Sent every interval_seconds from the accepted ping until the run's final event, so the start, from the ping to dev.qory.run.started, is covered too, or from dev.qory.run.started when the run has no server; a run is live from its accepted ping until its final event, or until no accepted event has arrived for 3 × interval_seconds.

elapsed_seconds.description: Seconds since the ping, or since dev.qory.run.started when the run has no server.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between heartbeats, so a receiver can detect a missed one.
